arrival: There's a room free if you need it. Take the one away from the kitchen; the chimney ticks after midnight.
The four who came before you stayed here. They asked about the old drains and bought enough lamp oil for a week.
mouth_lead: My father called the broad cut the public road. He said families came through it with carts before the village had a kiln.
Dob calls it a drain because he repaired it as one. Follow it north from the kiln and decide which work came first.
after_c02: A school and a market below. That sounds more like a refuge than the story I was told.
If you find a market token, show it to Coll. He knows the old issue marks better than I do.
after_p5: Copperline changed the old caption from shrine to lamp-service counter. I have stopped calling every carved room a temple.
The work cards can stay where people use them. The penalty copies belong where people can see who changed the rules.
after_p6: My father remembered Iss naming children who had never seen open sky. He also remembered Dob's old master asking about the stressed east bay. Iss answered the first part and moved past the second.
That does not make the surface claim false. It means the public speech left out the risk that made the route easier to sell.
after_c04: Pell worked the pumps with Nessa's family. Let him finish when he tells you what she filed.
Bad filter cloth and a hearing that hid it. People here blamed Nessa for years.
after_c07: There were four campers. Wren barely ate and checked the door whenever the pipes knocked. I thought he was only nervous.
Ash rented the back room and labelled camera batteries across the floor. I remember because I nearly stepped on them.
after_p11: Averyn was the registrar, not another Keeper. My father's story counted seven offices because it mixed the six people with the work they controlled.
I have corrected the room ledger. It names her work and leaves the old wording beside it, so nobody has to trust my memory alone.
coda: The humming stopped last night. The cups stayed still, and I slept until morning.
If anyone asks what happened, I'll give them the names and dates. They can make their own story from that.

townsfolk.role: gardener and keeper of local water memory

arrival: Mind the seedlings along the wall. I only moved them yesterday.
If you came about the well, don't drink from it. It isn't poison; the water just tastes strongly of iron.
well_lead: My gran tied white thread beneath the well lip when the reflection looked deeper than the rope. The thread is still there.
The Hold mouth is elsewhere. If this well reflects a roof instead of the sky, use the well then, and take someone with you.
after_c03: Sella taught drawing. The old school slates put north at the bottom because damp copies were read from the reverse.
Orin cut inspection marks on the undersides of stones. The upper faces were worn smooth by boots and water.
after_p5: The old sample card said to return one cup so the next draw could be compared. It did not ask anyone to make an offering.
Pera's school repair and our drain patch use the same reed packing. Dob still buys it from me every spring.
after_p6: Gran said Iss brought a living reed to the meeting and let every child touch it. She believed the surface was healing after that.
She also said Sella asked who would watch the cut crew. The copy of the speech we kept does not include that question.
after_c05: The copied house nearest the well keeps a clean repair entry, but the wall still carries the household patch beneath it.
One disagreement is not enough to tell us which version the copy follows. Bring back the other house findings before we call it a pattern.
after_unlit: You brought back seven house accounts, and none of them can stand in for the others. Keep the official changes beside the repairs people actually made.
The well still reflects the copied roof. Finishing the comparison did not make that behavior ordinary, and it did not make the repair safe by itself.
after_p8: The lower draw runs clear now. Dob used your pressure reading on the patch behind my wall, and it stopped knocking before dawn.
Keep the old dirty sample. Clean water proves the repair worked; it does not erase what was in the pipe.
after_p11: Averyn's sample notes use the same short marks as the old well cards. She was checking other people's work, not ruling a seventh Way.
Her name is back on the copy. The empty place below it can stay empty if that is what keeps the copy from owning her again.
coda: The white thread has gone slack. The reflection and the rope measure the same depth now; I checked twice.
I've planted reeds along the bank. They should take if the water stays level.

arrival: I have torches, rope, food, and spare boots. Check the soles before you go below.
Pay now or put your name on the tab. I keep one book for each and no other account.
after_c01: mkept bought paper, lamp oil, and a second map case. Paid in full and kept the receipt.
The receipt carried the old Copperline service number, 1842. I copied it before using the back for stock totals.
after_p5: A service exception is not a theft. If a school stove is broken, the lamp account can carry it until the mortar cures.
The later ledger turned those exceptions into offenses. Keep both copies. Do not pretend they are the same book.
camp_lead: Ash's group took four bundles: light, food, building, then recording. Rook repacked each bundle by receipt number.
Their map points east-northeast from the old kiln, then turns at the split pine. Wren's estimate was nearly twice the actual walk.
after_c07: Ash used locker thirteen for camera stock. The same number appears on the battery crate and film sheet.
Rook returned a coil of rope cut clean through. He said the lower room had copied a bridge change made only at camp.
after_p11: I found Averyn Pell's hand in three stock margins. The council copy kept the totals and dropped the person who checked them.
The corrected archive says registrar. It does not call her a Keeper, and it does not make the six less responsible.
coda: Your tab showed paid at dawn. I checked the total against my paper copy; it was correct.
Take a spare striker before you leave. I have enough now that the lower works are quiet.

arrival: You're going below? Check your boots first. A loose sole catches on the fourth stair landing.
I patched the drainage cut years ago. The stone behind it was older than the village work and cut much squarer.
mouth_lead: Aro calls the cut a public road. The slope, silt shelves, and side gates say drainage. A service cart could still fit through it.
Follow it north from the kiln. At the first flat slab, keep the water on your left. The worked arch faces the channel.
after_c02: There are three hands in the stone: rough shelter cuts, civic chisel work, then the dark pressure blocks.
The school walls and patched drains matter. People maintained that place for years.
after_p5: The low bow mark was an inspection position. You kneel because a standing eye cannot see the seam, not because stone wants respect.
Once the gallery is safe, I want to compare its old drain repair with the patch behind Wenna's wall.
after_p6: My old master heard Iss promise open sky and ask for a fast cut. Orin's brace warning was already on the table. The later speech copy names the promise and drops the warning.
Three memories do not give us exact words. They do agree that the hope was real and the omitted load was known.
after_c05: Three mineral seams crossed that crack before the fresh cut. The fracture was already moving.
Iss added load to a failing bay. That made it worse, but it did not create the original break.
after_p8: Your order held: filter, paired lamps, bypass, then the staff gate. Opening the gate first would have put someone under live pressure.
The old Hold repair and my surface patch use the same reed packing. I left your cut end beside mine so nobody can call that a coincidence later.
after_p11: Averyn's cut mark is on inspection copies, not on the six foundation stones. I should have noticed the difference before you brought the records together.
Leave the seventh socket empty. A missing stone and an unfilled office are not the same thing, even if they look alike from the door.
coda: I walked as far as the first gate this morning. It was open. I may go farther tomorrow.
The fourth landing still catches a loose sole. Mind it on the way out.

townsfolk.role: retired pump hand and family witness

arrival: Sit if you're staying. If you're asking about the pump, the iron taste has been there longer than I have.
Her name was Nessa Vale. The hearing called her only 'the tender,' and people here followed its lead.
cistern_lead: Nessa filed upper and lower draws separately every time. I watched her seal them at the pump table.
Toma Rill took cycle five after they removed her. His meal chit stayed in our drawer for years.
after_c04: If you cleared her, say the complete finding: Nessa followed procedure, the filter cloth failed, and the hearing hid the lower samples.
Write it down where people can return to it. One correct telling will not undo all the old ones.
after_p11: Averyn wrote the original finding. I knew a registrar had objected, but her name was missing from every copy I saw.
If she asks you not to enter her again, listen. A record is meant to serve the person named in it.
coda: Nessa Vale followed procedure. Counterfeit filters failed, and the hearing hid the lower samples. That remains the finding.
Whether Averyn's name is public or not, her evidence is attached now. No one can remove the finding by removing its author.

before_c07: We moved camp more than once. Ash wanted a clear view, Rook wanted a wall, and mkept wanted a live power line.
I gave Coll the wrong distance. I knew where the camp was and did not want anyone else finding it.
evidence_bridge: I said Rook changed the bridge after I left. That was false. He showed me the revision at camp.
No one else was there. When the lower room copied it, I knew where it had come from.
evidence_names: It asked for their names. I sent them because I believed a named person would be harder for the Record to erase.
It asked what they feared next. I sent that as well. I knew it could use those answers against them.
confession: I sent the route, the bridge revision, Ash's camera cache, mkept's login, and the private things they said at camp.
I believed closing the Record would erase me with it. I was afraid, and I chose to endanger them instead.
reckoning_condemn: I understand your decision. The evidence is mine, and I will not argue with it.
Take the Bridge. I will remain at the relay.
reckoning_understand: I know understanding is not forgiveness. I will not treat it as one.
I will carry the Bridge to the last threshold and follow your direction there.
reckoning_free: I do not know what remains of me outside this place, but I want the chance to find out.
Take the Bridge. If I leave, do not enter a destination for me.
coda_condemn: The relay line is closed. Wren left no further message.
coda_understand: Wren stayed until the machinery stopped. His bedroll is folded beside the console.
coda_free: Wren's bedroll and boots are gone. No departure was entered in the register.
